title_en: The Greatest Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) in Umayyad Heritage and Islamic Heritage (Episode 23)
summary: Part of the Debates in Creed series, this lecture features discussions by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on the legacy and historical portrayal of the Prophet Muhammad.
